roles/cloudfunctions.admin.title: Cloud Functions Admin
roles/cloudfunctions.admin.desc: Full access to functions, operations and locations. This role applies to functions created using the Cloud Functions API. For functions created using Cloud Run, refer to the Cloud Run roles and permissions page.

roles/cloudfunctions.developer.title: Cloud Functions Developer
roles/cloudfunctions.developer.desc: Read and write access to all functions-related resources. This role applies to functions created using the Cloud Functions API. For functions created using Cloud Run, refer to the Cloud Run roles and permissions page.

roles/cloudfunctions.editor.title: Cloud Functions Editor
roles/cloudfunctions.editor.desc: Editor role for Cloud Functions This role applies to functions created using the Cloud Functions API. For functions created using Cloud Run, refer to the Cloud Run roles and permissions page.

roles/cloudfunctions.invoker.title: Cloud Functions Invoker
roles/cloudfunctions.invoker.desc: Ability to invoke 1st gen HTTP functions with restricted access. 2nd gen functions need the Cloud Run Invoker role instead. This role applies to functions created using the Cloud Functions API. For functions created using Cloud Run, refer to the Cloud Run roles and permissions page.

roles/cloudfunctions.serviceAgent.title: (Deprecated) Cloud Functions Service Agent
roles/cloudfunctions.serviceAgent.desc: Gives Cloud Functions service account access to managed resources. This role applies to functions created using the Cloud Functions API. For functions created using Cloud Run, refer to the Cloud Run roles and permissions page.

roles/cloudfunctions.standardServiceAgen.title: Cloud Functions Service Agent
roles/cloudfunctions.standardServiceAgen.desc: Gives Cloud Functions service account access to managed resources.

roles/cloudfunctions.viewer.title: Cloud Functions Viewer
roles/cloudfunctions.viewer.desc: Read-only access to functions and locations. This role applies to functions created using the Cloud Functions API. For functions created using Cloud Run, refer to the Cloud Run roles and permissions page.
